extra.reason: Closed via fix: TDZ in constants.ts DT_* per-second rates (commit d3b78cd). Delta-time loop is now functional; bundle no longer throws ReferenceError at module init. Verified live on https://staging2.esponet.me/ — game mounts, draw:true, simulated cars=49.
Fixed in commit. HUD off-screen indicators now use actual world-space viewport dimensions instead of fixed CONSTANTS.VIEWPORT_WIDTH/HEIGHT (1280x720). Verified clean typecheck + production build.

Shipped: components/MuteToggle.tsx — fixed top-right circular button, aria-pressed + aria-label toggle, localStorage persist, immediately stops engine + siren on mute, explicit focus-visible cyan ring (>3:1 contrast), 48x48 target. Verified visually across viewports.

Server-side validateSubmission() (server/validate.js): rejects non-int/NaN/Infinity/negative/over-cap scores, caps name 1-24, validates+lowercases email, ignores client timestamp. Verified live (all 6 malformed payloads -> 400). Unit-tested (server/validate.test.js).
express-rate-limit on POST /api/leaderboard (10/min/IP) + express.json 8kb body cap + CORS scoped to dev origins. Verified live (429 after budget).
Added Vitest + vitest.config.ts; tests: utils/geometry.test.ts, server/validate.test.js. 11 tests pass. Scripts: test, test:watch, typecheck.
Added .github/workflows/ci.yml: npm ci + typecheck + test + build on push(main)/PR. Will prove out on next push.

Resolved for the actual (non-Fly) setup. App self-hosts via docker-compose with ./data:/data bind mount; SQLite at /data/leaderboard.db persists on the host. Verified LIVE locally: built hardened image (non-root node, npm ci), ran container, POSTed a score, 'docker restart', score survived; frontend+API serve at :3000. fly.toml [[mounts]] kept only for any future Fly deploy. No volume/sudo needed.

Normalized KeyboardEvent.key casing: useKeyPress now stores movement keys via normalizeKey() (single-char->lowercase), so Shift/CapsLock no longer break WASD/boost or strand a held key on keyup. useKeyPress also subscribes once via refs (no per-render re-subscription). Files: hooks/useKeyPress.ts, components/Game.tsx. Tests: hooks/useKeyPress.test.ts. tsc+14 tests+build pass.

Added e.repeat guards: E/C/M toggle handler and the RIDS-choice confirm now ignore auto-repeat, so held keys don't strobe the siren/minimap/colleague and a held SPACE from the RIDS check no longer auto-confirms Warn/Enforce. File: components/Game.tsx. (RIDS space check already had !e.repeat.)

HUD.tsx game-message toast keyed by gameMessage content instead of Date.now(), so the fade animation plays once per distinct message instead of remounting every render (flicker). File: components/HUD.tsx.

Siren rewritten to a continuous LFO sweeping oscillator frequency (utils/audio.ts sirenStart/sirenStop); removes the finite setValueCurve scheduling that decayed to a dead ~900Hz tone after ~5.6s. LFO torn down in sirenStop.

Wired audio to scoring: audio.zap() on handleWarn + handleEnforce (were silent), audio.pickup() (new soft blip) on deterrence-blob collect. File: components/Game.tsx, utils/audio.ts. NOTE: mini-game enforce success sound to be added in batch 4 retool.
Life-at-risk loss now gives visible feedback: cameraRef shake=10 + 'LIFE LOST' game message (2s), in addition to the existing thud + explosion. File: components/Game.tsx.

Added ambient music bed: utils/audio.ts musicStart/musicStop (low A-minor sawtooth pad through a slow-LFO lowpass); started/stopped with the shift in Game.tsx. Verified by typecheck+build; audio itself needs a manual listen.

Made reachable: handleEnforce now routes ALL enforce actions to the mini-game (Restraints/Distractions -> SituationalJudgement via existing MiniGameModal mapping). Also removed copy-pasted inline enforce block. Files: components/Game.tsx.

Retooled SituationalJudgement into a timeless General-vs-Specific deterrence classifier; explanation now revealed AFTER choosing (was shown unconditionally = answer key). Two native buttons + role=status live region + focus-visible + Continue button (per a11y review). Dropped perishable NZ-law content. File: components/mini-games/SituationalJudgement.tsx.

Siren now drains the shared boost energy pool (DT_SIREN_DRAIN_PER_SEC) and auto-disables when depleted or past PLAYER_SIREN_MAX_DURATION. Constants existed but were unused. File: components/Game.tsx (updatePlayerMovement).

LAR rebalanced: LIVES_SAVED_SCORE_BONUS 5000->2500, LIVES_LOST_PENALTY 3000->2500 so LAR-chasing no longer dominates the deterrence economy. Subjective tuning, noted in docs/review/implementation-notes.md. File: constants.ts.

PrecisionSlider rebuilt: slider driven by requestAnimationFrame (direct DOM write, no per-frame re-render) instead of a CSS keyframe, so the global prefers-reduced-motion reset no longer freezes it and forces a loss. Under reduced-motion, a non-timed ENFORCE alternative (no fail timer) — also the SR path. Native onClick on STOP, aria-live result, focus-visible, labelled TARGET zone. File: components/mini-games/PrecisionSlider.tsx.

Added frustum culling in gameRenderer.drawGame: onScreen() bound check guards every per-entity draw loop (civilians, skid marks, tire smoke, sparks, blobs, collection FX, floating text, explosions, patrol posts). Off-screen entities skipped entirely. File: utils/gameRenderer.ts.
Throttled setStationaryCountdown: was called every frame while stationary (60fps full re-render). Now value-change-gated (~10fps) via lastCountdownSigRef. File: components/Game.tsx.

Frame-rate independence: camera zoom/pos/shake now exponential dt-scaled smoothing (1-(1-k)^(dt*60)); impairment swerve scaled by dtScale; skid/tire-smoke spawns gated by Math.random()<dtScale so density is constant per second. File: components/Game.tsx.

Mitigated by frustum culling (gd-0wi.7): only on-screen cars (~10-20 vs up to 80) reach the shadowBlur path now. On-screen neon glow retained by design; full removal noted as optional aesthetic change in implementation-notes.md.

Removed the dead Dispatched-Call subsystem from the game loop (Game.tsx): dispatchedCallRef + lastDispatchCheckTime were only ever read/nulled, never assigned a call, so all dispatch branches (colleague-assist, pathfinding, enforce/warn bonus) were dead. Removed + unused DispatchedCall import. Always-null UI props (HUD/Compass/Minimap) + DISPATCH_CALL_* constants left as harmless vestiges (noted in implementation-notes.md).

Extracted resolveIntervention() shared by handleWarn + onMiniGameComplete, removing the copy-pasted score/vigilance/floating-text/deterrence/remove/LAR block. (handleEnforce inline dup was already removed in batch 4.) File: components/Game.tsx.

Removed per-frame allocations in the civilian update loop: inlined carVec (dot product) and perpVec (swerve perpendicular), and mutate c.pos in place at segment end instead of spreading a new object. ~1-2 fewer allocations per car per frame. Behavior-preserving (same math); verified by gameplay smoke test (loads+runs+drives, zero console errors). File: components/Game.tsx.
